# NovaTech Industries Annual Report

## Financial Results

### Revenue
Total revenue for fiscal 2024 was $12,400 million, compared to $10,800 million in fiscal 2023.

### Operating Margin
Operating margin (GAAP) was 21.3% for fiscal 2024, versus 19.8% (Non-GAAP, excluding one-time charges) in fiscal 2023.
The Non-GAAP operating margin for fiscal 2024 was 24.1% after adjusting for restructuring costs.

### Gross Margin
Gross margin for fiscal 2024 was 43.2%, down from 44.5% in fiscal 2023, driven by higher component costs.

## Balance Sheet

### Cash and Equivalents
Cash and equivalents at the end of fiscal 2024 stood at $3,100 million, up from $2,700 million a year earlier.

## Guidance

### Outlook
Management expects fiscal 2025 revenue to grow 8% year over year, with operating margin in the range of 20% to 23% (GAAP).
